subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The natural environment is in contrast with the 'built environment' which refers to areas that have been fundamentally transformed and __influenced __by human activity, such as cities, towns, substructures and so on.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3** i.e. **Fair**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Influenced** refers to to have an effect on or power over somebody/something so that he/she/it changes. (प्रभाव) 
 
• **"Fair"** refers to treating people equally without favoritism or discrimination; just. (उचित)
 
 
• **Example: **The judge gave a fair ruling based on the evidence presented.
 
 
 
• The natural environment is untouched and pure, while the built environment is constructed and altered by human action. Hence, the antonym of built is more accurately related to being fair and unprejudiced.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hackneyed** (पुराना): Something that is unoriginal or overused.

 
 
• **Example:** The hackneyed phrase lost its charm due to overuse.
 
 
 
• **Inimical** (हानिकारक): Something that is harmful or hostile.
 
 
• **Example:** The inimical weather conditions made it impossible to proceed with the expedition.
 
 
 
• **Interested** (रुचि रखने वाला): Showing curiosity or a desire to know or learn about something.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very interested in learning about different cultures.
